method: Fresh manual native-cell representative landmarks on exact final quantized pixels; all 59 frames visually inspected. Numeric samples do NOT stand in for all-frame numeric clearance. H_hair includes hair; H_skullEstimate estimates skull under hair and is low confidence. T consistently collar to black jacket hem, not to crotch/trouser folds. Segment coordinates are projected, not depth corrected.
